records.name: Canada Landsat Disturbance with pest (CanLaD), 1985-2024
records.description: 30 m Canada-wide detection and attribution of fire, harvest and pest-outbreak disturbance since 1985. Not consumed directly by the pipeline: it enters via cc-age-2025, where fRI Research used it as one of the four composited sources. Recorded here because it is the ONLY age source outside AB/BC in that composite, which is why the composite's coverage collapses there -- CanLAD is censored at 1985 by construction and cannot date an undisturbed stand. Classes are 1 wildfire, 2 harvesting, 3 other (windthrow, partial harvest, fire unconfirmed by NBAC), 4 water extension, 5 defoliation followed by harvest, 6-8 low/medium/high defoliation; only 1, 2 and 5 replace the stand, which matters because cc-age-2025 ages every class alike. A v1.1 extending to 2025 is also staged locally: it adds the 2025 year plus a cleanup pass (Sentinel-2 against false-positive defoliation, fires validated against NBAC) -- NOT pest attribution, which v1 already carries.

records.name: 2020 Land Cover of Canada (NALCMS, 30 m)
records.description: 30 m FAO-LCCS land cover (19 level-II classes, 15 applicable in Canada) from the Canada Centre for Remote Sensing; Canada's NALCMS contribution. Used as the CURRENT-CONDITIONS land cover in v3. Chosen over SCANFI because SCANFI LCC already drives the simulation, so reusing it for current conditions would be circular; the two are methodologically independent (NFI photo-plot training vs unsupervised clustering + expert interpretation; kNN imputation vs per-tile random forest). Two layers are derived: the simulation copy reclassifies urban to its nearest type (pre-industrial approximation), while the reporting copy retains urban.

extra.note: Series is 2010/2015/2020; no 2025 edition released as of 2026-08.

records.name: fRI Research current-condition stand age composite (age_in2025)
records.description: 30 m per-pixel stand age for 2025, built by fRI Research in ArcGIS as the per-pixel MINIMUM of four sources: BC VEG_COMP 2025, AB AVIE (to 2021), AB Crown AVI (to 2019) and CanLAD (1985-2024). NoData is 65535, which terra does NOT pick up from the tag -- it must be set explicitly. KNOWN LIMITATION: inventory input exists only in AB and BC; elsewhere CanLAD is the sole source and cannot date an undisturbed stand, so no pixel exceeds ~40 years and 78-100% carries no age at all. The gap is filled from ntems-forest-age-2022. SECOND KNOWN LIMITATION: the CanLAD step uses the disturbance year regardless of TYPE, so classes that do not replace the stand reset age too -- defoliation (6-8), 'other' (3: windthrow, partial harvest, unconfirmed fire) and water extension (4). Verified per pixel 2026-09-17: outside AB/BC every CanLAD-dated pixel carries 2025 - ending_year in every class, and those classes are 33% of dated pixels in LacSeulUpland (23% defoliation), 12% in ChurchillRiverUpland and 2.8% in WesternAlbertaUpland, where they also override AVIE through the MINIMUM. Old-seral area is understated as a result: LacSeul reads 23.3% old with the NTEMS fill against 26.9% if those classes did not reset age. fRI was asked on 2026-09-17 to rebuild keeping only CanLAD classes 1, 2 and 5. local_path is the delivered copy at the inputs root (so retrieved_at is the delivery date); LandWeb_preamble downloads and extracts its own copy under inputs/age2025/.
records.license: Access controlled / proprietary (AB AVIE not redistributable)

extra.canlad_classes: all 8 reset age; only 1/2/5 are stand-replacing

records.name: Canadian Wetland Inventory Map, version 3A (CWIM3A)
records.description: Natural Resources Canada's 10 m national wetland map (1 bog, 2 fen, 3 marsh, 4 swamp, 5 shallow water). SCANFI land cover has no wetland class, so data preparation takes wet ground from this layer (Biomass_borealDataPrep, wetlandSource = 'CWIM'): LandR::prepInputs_CWIM() counts bog, fen, marsh and swamp, and calls a cell wet when they cover at least half of it. The result adds wetland and treed wetland to the land cover and is the site axis of the siteComposition strata, so a species on upland and on wet ground gets its own maxB, maxANPP and establishment probability. The local file has the size of the one the URL serves (checked 2026-11-25).

records.name: Canada forest area by the FAO definition, 2022 (CA_FAO_forest_2022)
records.description: 30 m forest area for 2022 by the FAO definition, which counts land use: 1 current forest, 2 forest whose trees were removed by a stand-replacing disturbance (fire, harvest) and will return, 0 non-forest. The preamble's forest-land mask (LandR::forestLandMask()) takes classes 1 and 2 as forest land, with the ground SCANFI shows treed in any of its forest-land years (scanfi-lcc-2025). The local zip has the size of the one NFIS serves (checked 2026-11-25).

An earlier release kept on disk: the URL, fireregimetools' default and the one the local download stamp names, now serves a later release (778,498,701 bytes against this copy's 544,459,716) with no fire before 1972, and the CWFIS download area keeps only current_version/ (checked 2026-11-13). records.name: Canadian National Fire Database fire polygons before 1972 (release 20250630)

records.name: NTEMS Canada forest age, 2022
records.description: 30 m per-pixel forest age for every treed pixel in Canada's ~650 Mha of forested ecosystems, from three approaches: Landsat disturbance detection (1985+), spectral recovery (back to 1965), and allometric modelling for stands showing neither. Values are 0-150, 151 meaning '>150' (age is not resolved beyond that), and 255 non-treed -- 255 must be flagged NA or it enters a composite as a 255-year stand. Fills cc-age-2025's gaps outside AB/BC. This is also the source SBFI's own stand age is derived from, so the two are methodologically consistent. A companion _approach raster records which method produced each pixel (1/2/3; 0 non-treed). NOTE: on its own Lambert variant (NAD83 LCC, standard parallels 49/77, central meridian -95), NOT co-registered with cc-age-2025, so combining them is a true reprojection.

records.name: SCANFI v2 land cover, reclassified to NFI/EOSD codes (2020)
records.description: DERIVED product, not the published SCANFI layer: SCANFI's 8-class nfiLandcover relabelled 1:1 into NFI/EOSD numeric codes (1:8 -> 40, 100, 30, 50, 220, 210, 230, 20) by LandR::convert_SCANFI_LCC_codes(). Supplies rasterToMatch and the LCC input to Biomass_borealDataPrep. Upstream source is SCANFI_att_nfiLandcover_2020_v2_20260119.tif on the NRCan FTP; the DOI does not resolve to this file, and the hosted copy is access-controlled rather than openly downloadable.

records.name: SCANFI v2 land cover, reclassified to NFI/EOSD codes (2025)
records.description: DERIVED product, as scanfi-lcc-2020 but for 2025: SCANFI's 8-class nfiLandcover relabelled 1:1 into NFI/EOSD codes by LandR::convert_SCANFI_LCC_codes(). LandWeb_preamble builds rstLCC and rasterToMatch from it, read from the access-controlled Drive copy. The preamble also reads the 1985, 1995, 2005 and 2015 layers of the same series: ground SCANFI shows treed in any of those years or 2025 counts as forest land. Upstream source is SCANFI_att_nfiLandcover_2025_v2_20260119.tif on the NRCan FTP.

records.name: SCANFI v2 per-species crown closure (2020)
records.description: 30 m per-species percent crown-closure rasters; the v3 species initial-conditions source (SCANFI_spsCC_<code>_2020_v2_20260119.tif). Not in the public v2 release, which publishes only 10 species-group layers that are sums of these (e.g. white spruce is inside 'otherConiferous'). Distributed through the SCANFI team's restricted Google Drive folder and mirrored by PredictiveEcology.

records.name: SCANFI v2 per-species crown closure (2025)
records.description: 30 m per-species percent crown-closure rasters for 2025 (SCANFI_spsCC_<code>_2025_v2_20260119.tif), the species cover the per-study-area simulations start from (Biomass_speciesData). As for 2020, the public v2 release has only the 10 species-group layers for 2025. LandR reads the SCANFI team's restricted Drive folder through the PredictiveEcology mirror of it (LandR::scanfiUrlRemap()).

records.name: SCANFI v2 stand age and biomass (2020)
records.description: 30 m SCANFI attribute rasters (median stand age, biomass) used for v3 age/biomass initial conditions. Land cover is NOT this record: the pipeline consumes a derived reclassification, registered separately as scanfi-lcc-2020. The pipeline fetches these through LandR (Google Drive or the PredictiveEcology mirror); they are the same files as the public v2 release (identical size and sampled checksums, checked 2026-09-28).

records.name: SCANFI v2 stand age, biomass, canopy height and closure (2025)
records.description: 30 m SCANFI attribute rasters for 2025 that data preparation reads: biomass (rawBiomassMap); median stand age, only as the age covariate of the maxB/maxANPP fit (standAgeMapForMaxB; the cohorts take their age from cc-age-2025); and canopy height and closure, only to fit the deciduous cover weight. LandR fetches them by Drive id through the PredictiveEcology mirror. Each local file has the size of the file of the same name in the public v2 release (checked 2026-11-13).
